findings.title: A registered worktree owns any binding record, so a borrowed repo+label ends another checkout's schedule
PROTOCOL.md still says the pump `exec`s runners/orchid-tick, which the EXIT-trap fix deliberately changed

summary: The new ownership gate returns "owned" for every genuine linked worktree regardless of the path its record names, so the forged-record case its own comments defer to it is acted on rather than refused
